Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::createCashDesk(id: Integer,name: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		cd: CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->forAll(c: CashDesk|c.Id<>id)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		cd.oclIsNew() and
		cd.Id = id and
		cd.Name = name and
		cd.IsOpened = isopened and
		self.CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes->includes(cd)
}
